name: Khotachi Wadi - Ek Shapit Vaastu
overview: In the heart of Konkan lies ‘Khotachi Wadi’, a house sealed for years because of a dark curse. Draupadi Khot knows its terrible secret and has spent her life protecting her family from it. But when her granddaughter Sanika enters the mansion, the past awakens. ‘Khotachi Wadi’ is a deep psychological horror story of an unfinished past, an unbroken curse, and a spirit that refuses to let go.
